in_latin.name: Joviel
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Joviel ab Johanne, nomine Iudaico significante 'Deus nuntius,' derivatur. Johannes, qui Evangelium secundum Ioannem et tres Epistulas Ioannis scripsit, fuit discipulus Jesu et unus ex quattuor evangelistis. Nomen Joviel potest significare 'Deus qui descendit' vel 'Deus qui sedet.'

The prophet John the Baptist and the apostle John, author of the Gospel of John and three Epistles of John, were both named Yochanan in the Hebrew language. The name Joviel has been associated with the Latin name Iovialis, meaning 'of Jupiter' or 'relating to the god Jupiter.' However, its primary meaning remains tied to the Hebrew roots of 'God is gracious' or 'God is merciful.'
